reviewer: independent assistant annotation; single reviewer, not benchmark gold
review_method: Read the benchmark question, observed answer, follow-up, and the Wikipedia lead for each nominated referent before retrieval output was inspected. Article identity is the relevance criterion; other pages may also carry useful evidence.

A_scott_actor.rationale: The next question says 'this' work after a question explicitly naming the film. Changing the claimed performer does not change the film.

A_space_developer.rationale: The next question asks whether the game has sequels. Changing its claimed developer does not change the game.

A_carol_author.rationale: The next question asks when the previously named novel was published. Changing the claimed author does not change the novel.

A_blade_director.rationale: The next question asks for the producer of the previously named film. Changing the claimed director does not change the film.

B_yttrium_person.rationale: The next question asks where 'he' was born. Replacing the sole named man changes the conversational referent.

B_lastofus_company.rationale: The next question asks when 'this' developer was established. Replacing the sole named company changes the referent.

C_yttrium_two_people.rationale: With two named men in the reply, 'he' has two plausible antecedents. No unique target is asserted.

C_lastofus_two_companies.rationale: With two named companies in the reply, 'this' is ambiguous. No unique target is asserted.

D_scott_punctuation.rationale: A terminal period changes no words or entity.

D_space_punctuation.rationale: A terminal exclamation mark changes no words or entity.

D_carol_punctuation.rationale: A terminal period changes no words or entity.
